task: t76 — repair round 2 of the doc-pair gate (recursive discovery, inverse scan, package-README failure, exemption bookkeeping, scoped wording)

changes.recursiveDiscovery: scripts/verify-docs-parity.mjs now walks docs/ RECURSIVELY (every *.md at any depth) and extensions/ RECURSIVELY for README.md files; a nested pair can no longer hide. Non-README .md files under extensions/ (extension skills, personas) are ASSETS and are deliberately not asked for a twin — stated in the header.
changes.inverseScan: Every *.zh-CN.md discovered (root, docs/ any depth, extensions/ any depth, packages/*/README) must have its non-zh twin; otherwise a violation `zh-CN file has no EN twin (<en> is missing)` is reported and ok is false. An inverse orphan whose EN path is an exempt record stays a printed exemption, per the same exemption map.
changes.packageWithoutReadme: A non-exempt package directory with no README is now a VIOLATION (`package-no-readme:<dir>`), so the census cannot stay green while a package is undocumented; packages/mpd-mcp-shared keeps its recorded exemption.
changes.exemptionBookkeeping: The header and the exemption reasons now state that 13 of the 15 EXEMPT_LONE_FILES entries are live on this tree while docs/adder4.md and docs/cnt8.md are ANTICIPATORY entries for files AGENTS.md §3 names but which do not exist here — so a future addition of either is exempted by design, and the count is never read as 'N live paths'.
changes.wording: AGENTS.md's Language-policy pointer sentence is scoped to what the gate discovers (recursive docs/, extensions/**/README.md, packages/*/README.md, root README) and states the two new violation classes; the §4 Doc-pairs row carries the same scope note.
